actions.name: GENERATE_FIELD_VOLUME
actions.sideEffect: SELECT-only saved result export. Source file summaries retained as planning values; no ERP writes.

actions.name: GENERATE_UPLOADED_FIELD_VOLUME
actions.sideEffect: Authenticated file-only conversion. Active Customer display-name lookup only, zero writes; no matching or apply prerequisite. Source weekday, units and summaries preserved. Print assigned farm quantities as entered, independently of source shipment quantities. Omit raw text and unresolved notes. Previous subweek not inferred. Authenticated year/week source archive stores raw xlsx on the private server disk. Checked source families alone contribute to pallet totals. Verified saved plans read current scoped shipment/farm rows for download.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/46-01 excluded from 2026/46-02; same actual date and prior subweek only; future subweek excluded.

presentation.weekdayLayout: One cultivar row; each weekday starts a new line within column C, retaining existing 7/10 customer wrapping.
presentation.routeHeading: Column C beside weekday-region heading lists customer total(cultivar quantity,...), grouped by CustKey and ProdKey within date/region/unit.
presentation.previousSelection: Cultivar breakdown includes previous only when includePrevious is not false; never substitutes farm assignment quantity.
presentation.palletBoxes: Append source snapshot box quantity (up to six decimal places) beside rounded pallets; never reverse rounded pallets. Existing capacities and rose 10 / Snow Flake 25 bundle-to-box conversion preserved.
presentation.print: Single worksheet, day-first merged weekday heading blocks in footer only after total; canonical suggestDisplayName plus trusted display aliases, unknown cultivar labels preserved; A3 landscape; original D/E/F/G values and remaining-stock formulas retained.

sourceSummary.rule: Sum distinct physical source rows for the same matched product exactly once; deduplicate customer columns and repeated name blocks. Preserve original formula cached zero values. Infer blank zero only from the source equation.
sourceSummary.nearMiss: Reject one physical row mapped to multiple product keys or conflicting per-unit conversion factors.
sourceSummary.staleFormat: field-volume-v1 tokens are rejected before DB access; revalidation issues field-volume-v2.
